concept: SQS FIFO: strict ordering and exactly-once
tests: Choosing a decoupling service that buffers spikes, preserves strict processing order and has no duplicates.
expected: SQS FIFO queue — guarantees ordering and exactly-once processing, buffers bursts. Triggers: "exactly in the sequence received", "never duplicated", "decouple".
why_not: SQS standard — duplicates possible and best-effort ordering; SNS — pub/sub without buffering; Firehose — delivers streams to storage, not a job queue.
